task.description:
Validate OIDC-09 for release. Follow WF-04 Steps 6-8:

1. Verify all MUST acceptance criteria are met by reading test report: tests/reports/report-WF02-oidc09-20260527-step04b.json
2. Run: zig build bench (set BPM_TEST_DB_URL env var) — verify NFR results pass
3. Run: zig build test (must exit 0)
4. Run: zig build test-integration-oidc09 (set BPM_TEST_DB_URL env var, must exit 0)
5. Produce release decision at docs/status/release-OIDC-09-20260527.json with PASS/FAIL

OIDC-09 acceptance criteria:
- First login of a new OIDC user creates exactly one local record.
- Subsequent logins for the same OIDC user do not create duplicates.
- The created record has auth_source = 'oidc'.
- JIT provisioning failure blocks auth (returns 401/500).
acceptance_criteria: All acceptance criteria verified via test report
